strings.status_full: A·sok jwk zero ja·a phwrwia. Phwila jwk kwrwngwi — khlaiya jwk zero manda nwng.
strings.status_fast: Kok, kwmbwr aro 4 MB phati phwrwia. Tvwla nwng phwrwi, indiba rakkha manda, sada khlaiya jwk a·sok phwila jwk kwrwngwi. Hokwm lekha-ni a·sok mode no jakaya.
strings.error_permission: Fail-o rwchab kwrwngwi. Tvla program-o khaia tongo. Khaia aro phwila rwchab.

strings.error_is_symlink: Nwng symbolic link. Link-rwk noksa khlai kwrwngwi — kanchwng fail rakkha tongo.
strings.error_reparse: Nwng jayga fail (OneDrive eba sai). Data cloud-o tongo, disk-o nwng — no noksa khlai jwk bache.
strings.error_not_file: Nwng fail nwng (folder eba tvwla). Fail salongo.
strings.error_hardlinks: Naa fail-o tvla hard link tongo ({n} a·sok). Hard link-o mwrwi kwrwngwi — mukmung jwk a·sok. Sai rwchab no noksa khlaio, data phwrwia aro 32 byte-o rwchapgwno, indiba tongo jwk tvwla link-chi rwchab kwrwngwi. Kwno a·sok link-rwk khwlai.
strings.error_compressed: Fail nwng dongwi, enkrip eba swng. Zero-o phwrwia manda tokmwng data noksa khlai rakkha-kwo tongo, maina NTFS tvwla rwchab-o do.
